_comment: The promo's soundtrack. orbit-original-a is our own composition, arranged on the film's bar grid from Apple's
GarageBand loops (royalty-free inside an original soundtrack; the loops themselves are never committed).
bpm: the beat grid. downbeat: bar 0 of that grid, the reveal (the track starts at bar -2, the film's first frame).
edit: [film_bar, track_bar] pairs. Film bar 0 is the reveal at 4.0s on the film's 120 BPM grid (bar n starts
at 4 + 2n film seconds); from that film bar on, the music plays from that track bar. The film is time-scaled
by bpm/120 so its cuts land on the track's beats. The last segment plays out to the track's own ending.
fade_in: seconds of fade at the very start (0 = start clean on a downbeat).
key_root: pitch class of the (major) key, for the in-key UI chimes (0 = C).

orbit-original-a.title: Orbit Original A (keynote indie-pop)
orbit-original-a.sections: bar -2 filtered intro, -1 build + riser, 0 drop (reveal), 4 lead guitar, 5.5 two-beat drop-out, 6 notch hit, 8 a stab per verb, 9 second peak, 12 logo hit + ring-out
